response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM r), s1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a FROM r, m1 WHERE r.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.rating, s1.a FROM s1, m2 WHERE s1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(s2.a) AS mean_remaining_avg_length, AVG(s2.a - m1.m) AS avg_above_first_average, AVG(s2.a - m2.m) AS avg_above_first_cut_mean FROM s2, m1, m2
